ModMetaData.name: FixWorld
ModMetaData.author: SmolBlackHole
ModMetaData.description:
FixWorld is a performance optimization mod for RimWorld focused on making the game faster without changing how it plays.
It improves selected parts of RimWorld's loading and runtime systems through caching, staged initialization, reduced redundant work, and targeted optimizations.
Current work includes faster mod loading, persistent texture caching, improved initialization, loading diagnostics, and runtime performance improvements.
Future updates may target map generation, pathfinding, simulation performance, and other expensive systems.
FixWorld aims to preserve vanilla behavior while reducing unnecessary CPU time, loading delays, and repeated work.
